# Swim Analytics — AnalyticsZone

> Privacy-first swim training analytics for iOS and Apple Watch: Critical Swim Speed (CSS), swim training load (STSS), and stroke metrics computed locally on your device — no cloud uploads.

Swim Analytics tracks Critical Swim Speed, Training Stress Score, and performance metrics for swimmers, triathletes, and coaches. All metrics are based on peer-reviewed sports science and computed on-device.

## Key pages

- [Critical Swim Speed (CSS)](https://swim.analyticszone.app/en/css/): What CSS is, how to test it, and an interactive CSS calculator (400m/200m protocol).
- [CSS vs Threshold Pace](https://swim.analyticszone.app/en/css-vs-threshold/): How CSS relates to lactate threshold pace and when to use each.
- [Swim Training Load (STSS)](https://swim.analyticszone.app/en/training-load/): Quantifying swim training stress, session by session.
- [STSS Calculator](https://swim.analyticszone.app/en/stss-calculator/): Interactive swim training stress calculator.
- [Training Zones](https://swim.analyticszone.app/en/training-zones/): CSS-anchored swim training zones.
- [Stroke Mechanics](https://swim.analyticszone.app/en/stroke-mechanics/): SWOLF, stroke rate, and stroke count metrics.
- [Formulas](https://swim.analyticszone.app/en/formulas/): Every formula the app uses, with references.
- [Research](https://swim.analyticszone.app/en/research/): The sports-science literature behind the metrics.

## Key facts

- Critical Swim Speed (CSS) is estimated from a 400m and a 200m time trial: CSS (m/s) = (400 − 200) / (T400 − T200), where times are in seconds.
- CSS approximates the swimming equivalent of critical power: the fastest pace that can be sustained in a metabolically steady state.
- STSS (Swim Training Stress Score) quantifies swim session load relative to CSS, analogous to TSS in cycling.
- All calculations run locally on the device; no training data is sent to any cloud.
